name: IIIT 5K-Word Dataset for Scene Text Recognition
description: A widely used cropped word dataset for evaluating natural scene text recognition algorithms, created by the Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT) at IIIT Hyderabad. Contains 5,000 cropped word images harvested from Google image search queries (signboards, billboards, posters, house numbers). Each image is accompanied by ground truth character transcriptions and paired with 50-word and 1,000-word lexicon sets.
